records.text: Owens claimed that 85% of Gaza had been destroyed in a pre-planned, controlled demolition and said Netanyahu was on camera before October 7 calling for Gaza to be hit so hard it could not recover.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: 85% of Gaza has been destroyed in this pre-planned controlled demolition of Gaza. Bibi Netanyahu (Benjamin Netanyahu) is on camera explicitly before October 7 saying we need to hit them so hard that they can't come back.

verification.notes: Authoritative assessments support catastrophic and widespread destruction: UN reporting later estimated at least 92% of Gaza housing units were damaged or destroyed by October 2025. That does not validate the episode's imprecise '85% of Gaza' formulation, and the reviewed sources do not establish that the destruction was a pre-planned controlled demolition. Searches also did not locate an authenticated pre-October-7 Netanyahu video with the exact claimed wording, so that component remains unsupported rather than false.

records.text: Owens accused Jared Kushner of standing to benefit financially from whatever was built in Gaza's place and said the plan began before October 7.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jared Kushner is involved in—he will financially benefit from whatever they build in its place. Again, all of this began before October 7th, right?

verification.notes: Current sources document potential conflict-of-interest concerns involving Kushner's foreign-funded investment business and his later official Gaza reconstruction/investment role. They do not establish that Kushner personally stood to profit from a particular replacement project in Gaza, or that such a profit plan began before October 7, 2023. Potential conflicts and later policy roles are not proof of the specific accusation.
